edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside _onlyOwner.
_onlyOwner implements the onlyOwner modifier guard.
onlyOwner modifier restricts initiateRelay to the contract owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts initiateRelayBatch to the contract owner.
msg.sender is the checked subject of the require in _onlyOwner.
owner state variable is the expected value in the require comparison.
_onlyOwner reverts when the require check fails.
msg.sender is compared with nominatedOwner in acceptOwnership.
nominatedOwner state variable is the expected value in the acceptOwnership require.
acceptOwnership only proceeds if the caller is the nominated owner.
acceptOwnership copies nominatedOwner into owner.
nominateNewOwner receives the candidate owner parameter.
nominateNewOwner writes the new candidate into nominatedOwner.
target parameter flows into initiateRelay.
payload parameter flows into initiateRelay.
crossDomainGasLimit parameter is consumed by _getCrossDomainGasLimit.
targets parameter flows into initiateRelayBatch.
payloads parameter flows into initiateRelayBatch.
targets length participates in the batch length require.
payloads length participates in the batch length require.
initiateRelayBatch aborts when array lengths mismatch.
CONTRACT_EXT_MESSENGER key is used by _messenger to resolve the messenger.
CONTRACT_OVM_OWNER_RELAY_ON_OPTIMISM key is used by _ownerRelayOnOptimism.
_messenger calls requireAndGetAddress to fetch the cached messenger address.
_ownerRelayOnOptimism calls requireAndGetAddress to fetch the relay address.
requireAndGetAddress reads from the addressCache mapping.
_getCrossDomainGasLimit falls back to getCrossDomainMessageGasLimit for the default.
resolved gas limit is passed into the sendMessage call in initiateRelay.
resolved gas limit is passed into the sendMessage call in initiateRelayBatch.
target is encoded into messageData.
payload is encoded into messageData.

messageData is produced by abi.encodeWithSelector.
targets is encoded into the batch messageData.
payloads is encoded into the batch messageData.

encoded messageData is the calldata argument of sendMessage in initiateRelay.
encoded messageData is the calldata argument of sendMessage in initiateRelayBatch.
_messenger result is the receiver of the external sendMessage call in initiateRelay.
_messenger result is the receiver of the external sendMessage call in initiateRelayBatch.
_ownerRelayOnOptimism result is the sendMessage target argument in initiateRelay.
_ownerRelayOnOptimism result is the sendMessage target argument in initiateRelayBatch.
external cross-domain messenger call is an outbound interaction that could allow reentrancy into the relay entrypoint if the messenger address were attacker controlled.
external cross-domain messenger batch call is an outbound interaction that could allow reentrancy into the batch relay entrypoint.
resolverAddressesRequired uses combineArrays to merge address lists.
existingAddresses is the first input of combineArrays.
newAddresses is the second input of combineArrays.
rebuildCache consumes the required addresses returned by resolverAddressesRequired.
resolver state variable is used by rebuildCache to refresh the cache.
rebuildCache writes resolved destinations into addressCache.

normalization_plan.reason: The target parameter is only meaningful as an argument of initiateRelay and should be folded into that core function node.
The payload parameter is only consumed by initiateRelay and is normalized into that function.
The gas-limit parameter is directly processed by _getCrossDomainGasLimit and can be merged into it.
The targets array is only used inside initiateRelayBatch and normalizes into that function.
The payloads array is only used inside initiateRelayBatch and normalizes into that function.
The candidate owner parameter is exclusively used by nominateNewOwner and merges into it.
messageData is the direct product of abi.encodeWithSelector inside initiateRelay and normalizes into that unsafe operation.
The batch messageData is produced by abi.encodeWithSelector and normalizes into that unsafe operation.
